[RDSC.16.2.7] **A capability the build lacks.** Before decoding any atom
body other than the header and the `CapabilityInfo` atom, the runtime must compare
`requires` against the capabilities it was built with. For a member of
`requires` it lacks, including a `Capability` value it does not know, the
load fails with `DS_ERR_DSC_CAPABILITY_ABSENT`. When several are lacking,
the error names the lowest, so the answer is stable. The detail names the
capability as a value of `proto/capabilities.proto#Capability`.

This code means only that the runtime was compiled without the code. An
artefact whose settings the integration does not admit is a policy
refusal, `DS_ERR_BND_DIALECT_MISMATCH` ([NLFC.10]), and the two must stay
distinct.
gap_reason: Needs a runtime built without a capability's code; the conformance corpus runs against the full build. The stub-RE2 build of the C unit suite is where it is pinned.
